title: Squash and Stretch: An idea lands and connects

scenes.title: The idea lands
scenes.purpose: A glossy teal jelly ball (the idea) performs a full contact-aware squash-and-stretch bounce.
visuals: Cool icy gray-white studio sweep with faint stationary wall dots, a floor gradient and an ink #32444A floor line
Teal #66978E jelly ball: an outer group for translation, an inner squash group pivoting at the contact point, and a path that flattens on contact
Teal floor light and contact shadow that shrink as the ball rises
Dotted trajectory revealed behind the ball
Static copy: 'An idea lands —', 'and connects.', the figure label and the six stage labels

beats.development: Anticipation: sy 0.85 with the base flattened against the floor.
Launch stretch along velocity (sy 1.25, tilted 18°). The ball rises on a parabola and relaxes round near the apex while the trail draws.
Hang, then fall stretch (sy 1.25, tilted -18°). The floor glow grows as the ball approaches.
Impact (sx 1.3, sy 1/1.3, fully flattened base), rebound, a small hop, a soft landing and settle.

scenes.title: It connects
scenes.purpose: A heavier clay jelly block hops in on its own cue and wobbles to rest, then lines join the bodies and nodes into a system.
visuals: Clay #C78461 jelly block with the same nesting and a contact pivot at its base
Clay floor light and contact shadow
Two small jelly nodes popping in
Five ink links drawn between the bodies and nodes

beats.development: The ball rests while the block anticipates (sy 0.85, flattened base) and launches stretched (sy 1.25, tilted -12°).
A lower, shorter hop leftward: round at the peak, stretched on the descent.
Impact (sx 1.3, sy 1/1.3), then a damped jelly settle with the base planted and the top lagging (s 1.12/0.94/1.03/1, shear 7°/-4°/1.5°/0). Nodes pop in, links draw, and the underline draws.
Hold on the complete, settled system.

findings: Copy is static and readable for the full 3 seconds.
Only one body deforms at a time: the ball from 0 to 1.4s, the block from 1.4 to 2.54s.
The scene is fully settled by 2.6s, before the 2.7s target.
justifiedHolds: From 1.4 to 1.6s the ball holds while the block anticipates, separating the two cues.
From 2.6 to 3.0s the final hold lets the connected system read.

notes: Silent preview with no music, effects or lyrics.
Renderer: SVG. Motion: one paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video.
